# ThePickleHub

> ThePickleHub (thepicklehub.net) is Vietnam's bilingual (Vietnamese-English) pickleball platform: free tournament management software, live streaming, video replays, pro tour news (PPA, MLP, APP, PPA Tour Asia), the Vietnam DUPR leaderboard, and a community feed. ~95% of users are Vietnamese; all key content is available in both English and Vietnamese (/vi/ routes).

ThePickleHub is built and operated in Vietnam. It covers Vietnamese pickleball — tournaments, players, venues, federation news — plus PPA Tour Asia and the global pro scene. Tournament tools (round robin, single/double elimination brackets, MLP-style team match, live scoring) are free and require no signup for organizers to try.

## Key Pages

- [Home (EN)](https://www.thepicklehub.net/): platform overview
- [Trang chủ (VI)](https://www.thepicklehub.net/vi): Vietnamese homepage
- [Blog (EN)](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog): guides on rules, technique, DUPR, tournaments, pro tours
- [Blog (VI)](https://www.thepicklehub.net/vi/blog): Vietnamese guides and venue directories
- [News](https://www.thepicklehub.net/news): aggregated pickleball news, translated EN↔VI
- [Vietnam DUPR Rankings](https://www.thepicklehub.net/rankings): live Vietnam DUPR leaderboard
- [Live](https://www.thepicklehub.net/live): livestreams of Vietnamese tournaments and matches
- [Tournament Tools](https://www.thepicklehub.net/tools): free bracket generator, round robin, team match, live scoring

## Notable Guides

- [Vietnam Pickleball Tournament Calendar 2026](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog/vietnam-pickleball-tournament-calendar-2026): every major event incl. Pickleball World Cup Da Nang
- [PPA Tour Asia 2026 Complete Guide](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog/ppa-tour-asia-2026-complete-guide): schedule, prize money, how to play
- [What Is DUPR?](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog/what-is-dupr-pickleball-rating-system): rating system explainer (3-part series)
- [Pickleball Rules 2026](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog/pickleball-rules-complete-guide): complete rulebook with disputed calls in Asian tournaments
- [How to Organize a Pickleball Tournament](https://www.thepicklehub.net/blog/how-to-organize-pickleball-tournament): step-by-step organizer guide
